answer.summary: A new, focused research question is required to investigate explicit memory mechanisms in response to structured perturbations beyond previously examined triggers or thresholds.
answer.content: Identify whether Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 reports any explicitly defined memory update policies that activate upon specific temporal patterns of input (e.g., periodicity, sequence length, or gap duration) under known perturbations, and if so, define the shortest observed interval between inputs that triggers a detectable memory update event as an anchor for persistence claims.
